svg.title: Which Power11 server fits
svg.desc: The five Power11 servers, what each is for and the most it holds, as IBM states it: Power S1112, 2U rack or tower, remote, branch and near-edge sites, up to 512 GB of memory; Power S1122, 2U, small to midsized businesses and space-constrained sites, up to 60 cores and 4 TB of memory; Power S1124, 4U, enterprises and regional data centers, up to 60 cores and 8 TB; Power E1150, 4U, memory- and data-intensive workloads, up to 120 cores and 16 TB; Power E1180, a full rack, the largest and most complex mission-critical workloads, up to 256 cores and 64 TB.
